Type: chair
Name: Strathwood Brook Dining Armless Chair, Set of 2
Colors: Brown
Materials: aluminum
Set of 2 outdoor chairs for use with dining table or on their own Powder-coated aluminum frame with faux wood resin slats; chairs are stackable for easy storage Contemporary style; coordinates with matching Brook furniture (sold separately) No assembly required; cover/store during inclement weather; imported Each measures 19 inches long by 25 inches wide by 35 inches tall; each weighs 8 pounds
